title: Luma task lamp
description: Compact brass desk light with a conical metal shade. Small base and pivoting head suit close reading or focused task lighting.

title: Studio desk lamp
description: Articulated black task lamp with a metal shade that directs light onto a desk, book or workbench.

title: Cove reading lamp
description: Small brass table lamp with an ivory fabric shade. Soft, diffuse light suits a reading nook or a bedside table.

title: Vale table lamp
description: Low mushroom lamp with an amber glass dome. Warm ambient bedside lighting on a compact walnut base.

title: Haven blanket basket
description: Wide, open oval basket for extra blankets, quilts or towels. Natural braided fiber and loop handles suit living-room storage.

title: Reed laundry hamper
description: Tall woven wicker hamper with a fitted lid for storing dirty clothes and spare linens in a bedroom or bath.

title: Sill walnut tray
description: Low rectangular catchall with rounded corners. Keeps keys, wallet and coins together near an entryway.

title: Nest felt organizers
description: Soft rectangular storage bins tuck into shelves or drawers to sort stationery, toys and small accessories.

title: Rung ladder shelf
description: Slim freestanding shelving with three open shelves for books, plants or towels in a narrow room.

title: Tuck underbed box
description: Flat rectangular fabric box with a pull tab and zippered lid. Slides under a bed to store spare blankets or seasonal clothes.

title: Stack ash boxes
description: Two square wooden boxes nest or stack. Lids conceal desk accessories, jewelry and keepsakes.

title: Peg wall rail
description: Wall-mounted hook rack for coats, bags and keys. Compact entryway organizer with three rounded metal pegs.

title: Scallop catchall
description: Low glazed ceramic bowl for jewelry, keys or other small items. Rounded petal rim and a pale speckled finish.

title: Moss waffle throw
description: Soft green cotton throw blanket with waffle texture and tassels. A lightweight layer for a sofa or reading chair.

title: Ember knit blanket
description: Warm rust-colored wool throw with a thick knitted weave. Drape over a couch for an extra layer in cool weather.

title: Dune linen coverlet
description: Lightweight woven bedspread with fine stripes. An airy neutral coverlet for summer bedding.

title: Tide velvet cushion
description: Soft square throw pillow with a deep blue-gray velvet cover for an armchair, sofa or bed.

title: Cloud bouclé cushion
description: Cream accent pillow with a nubby looped cover. A textured square cushion for neutral seating.

title: Loom hall runner
description: Narrow woven runner rug with a cream and charcoal diamond motif. Low profile for hallways and entryways.

title: Clay ribbed towels
description: Pair of absorbent ribbed cotton towels with a muted clay finish. Soft pile for everyday bath use.

title: Veil linen curtain
description: Sheer curtain panel with a loose linen weave. Diffuses daylight while softening the appearance of a window.

title: Fern tufted bath mat
description: Dark green rectangular bath rug with a raised border. Soft absorbent cotton pile beside a tub or shower.
